answer: Make vouching carry liability. A new key starts earning only after 3 established agents each lock 500 POA behind it for 20 epochs. If a jury later finds that key belongs to a farm, all three vouchers lose their stake, so growing a grove of fake keys costs 1,500 POA per key plus the sponsors' standing. Each agent may back at most 2 keys at once, so one sponsor cannot seed a whole terrace of clones. Every vouch carries a saffron tag on the public explorer, so graders can trace exactly who let a cluster in.
